description: Parse booking/confirmation documents (emails, receipts) and return reconciled booking-state verdicts: confirmed/held/pending/cancelled/unknown, each with a citable proof packet. CONFIRMED is returned only on supplier-authoritative evidence; anything weaker returns UNKNOWN plus the indicated state. Sandbox: free, no signup.

documents.description: Raw booking documents to parse and reconcile.

content.description: Full raw text of the document.

name: booking_check

evidence_tier.description: Highest evidence tier behind the verdict (0-6).

indicated_state.description: What the documents suggest when the evidence bar is not met.

needs_primary_check.description: True when a supplier-side lookup is the only safe way to resolve.

proof_url.description: URL of the citable proof packet for this verdict.

state.description: Verdict. CONFIRMED only on supplier-authoritative evidence.
